leaves.name: mainTheoremCM
leaves.doc: qmrec-printed: the main theorem of complex multiplication, adelic form with torsion (printed form): for a CM field E with CM type Phi, its reflex field E* (generated by the type traces) and reflex norm N (det_E on a model of C^Phi over E*), sigma in Aut(C) and an idele s of E* with sigma = [s, E*] on E*^ab (Tau Ceti's Artin map), an abelian variety A/C uniformized by C^g/Phi(a) of type (E, Phi): A^sigma is uniformized by C^g/Phi(t^-1 a), t = N(s)^eps, with theta(Phi(x))^sigma = theta'(Phi(y)) whenever t y - x lies in a-hat. Sign eps existential (Shimura's normalization: eps = 1). Proves QMReciprocityL3 (qmReciprocityL3_of_textbook) and with shimura-split2's glue the field rayClassCMAb.
leaves.source: Shimura, Introduction to the arithmetic theory of automorphic functions (1971) section 5.5; Shimura, Abelian varieties with complex multiplication and modular functions (1998) section 18, Thm 18.6; Shimura-Taniyama (1961) sections 13-14; Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) Thm 11.2; Milne, Complex multiplication (notes) section 9 (locators UNVERIFIED)

leaves.name: pelHolFamily
leaves.doc: holfam: the PEL moduli scheme M_K3 of QM abelian surfaces with level 3 with its universal family and complex uniformization: a curve S proper and smooth of relative dimension 1 over Q, a QM abelian scheme with level-3 structure over S (QMAbScheme) whose field fibres are objects (QML3), and a holomorphic tau -> s_tau in S(C) on the upper half plane (ShimuraSplit.IsHolFamily) whose fibre is, by an iota-compatible analytic uniformization with kernel iota(O)(tau,1)^T, the torus C^2/iota(O)(tau,1)^T. No fine witness in the statement; implies ShimuraHolModAll (shimuraHolModAll_of_pel, proved) and is implied by ShimuraHolFamilyAb (pelHolFamily_of_hol, proved).
leaves.flag: pending reading: whether Deligne 1971 sections 4.9-4.17 / Example 5.8 (or Milne ISV sections 8 and 14) state the identification of M_K(C) with G(Q)\X x G(A_f)/K as analytic spaces together with the family C^2/Lambda(x,g) for the integral O-linear level-3 PEL datum of B (disc 6) over Q
leaves.source: Deligne, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 4.9-4.17 and Example 5.8; Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) sections 8 and 14; Shimura, Ann. of Math. 78 (1963) (analytic families) and 85 (1967) Main Theorem I (locators UNVERIFIED)
